name: call_id
description: Unique LLM telemetry call identifier (insertId deduplication key)

name: recorded_at
description: UTC timestamp when the LLM model call completed

name: session_id
description: Conversational session identifier associated with the call

name: user_id
description: Authenticated Workspace / IAP principal invoking the turn

name: agent_name
description: ADK agent executing the model call (e.g., FinancialAnalystAgent, NarrativeEvaluatorAgent)

name: model_name
description: Gemini model identifier (e.g. gemini-3.8-flash or gemini-3.5-flash-lite)

name: task_category
description: Workload classification routed across Pro vs Flash tiers

name: react_phase
description: Active ReAct loop phase during this model invocation

name: system_instruction_tokens
description: Tokens in system instructions and ReAct protocol headers

name: memory_and_history_tokens
description: Tokens from conversational session history and recalled memory

name: variance_payload_tokens
description: Tokens representing deterministic variance calculation payloads

name: cached_10k_tokens
description: Tokens served from cached 10-K filing sections

name: uncached_10k_and_tool_tokens
description: Uncached RAG chunks and tool response tokens

name: user_prompt_tokens
description: Tokens in the active analyst prompt

name: total_context_tokens
description: Total input context tokens supplied to the model call

name: cached_context_tokens
description: Input tokens served via Vertex AI / session context cache

name: uncached_context_tokens
description: Input tokens requiring full uncached prefill processing

name: cache_hit
description: Whether context cache hit accelerated this model call

name: output_tokens
description: Generated candidate response tokens

name: thoughts_tokens
description: Internal reasoning / thinking tokens

name: total_model_latency_ms
description: End-to-end model call latency including context prep (ms)

name: context_prep_latency_ms
description: Latency spent loading memory/cache and assembling prompt context (ms)

name: context_prefill_latency_ms
description: Model prefill latency attributable to processing input context tokens (ms)

name: context_latency_ms
description: Total latency attributable to context (prep + prefill, ms)

name: generation_latency_ms
description: Output token decode / generation latency (ms)

name: ttft_ms
description: Time to First Thought / Token in milliseconds

name: context_latency_ratio
description: Fraction of total model call latency attributable to context

name: latency_per_1k_context_tokens_ms
description: Normalized context latency per 1,000 input context tokens (ms)

name: estimated_cache_latency_saved_ms
description: Estimated prefill latency saved via cached 10-K context tokens (ms)

name: within_ttft_slo
description: Whether TTFT satisfied the <= 3000ms p95 SLO

name: input_cost_usd
description: USD cost of input tokens after applying cached-token discount

name: output_cost_usd
description: USD cost of generated output and thinking tokens

name: total_cost_usd
description: Total USD cost for this LLM invocation

name: uncached_baseline_cost_usd
description: Hypothetical USD cost had all cached tokens been billed at uncached rate

name: cached_token_savings_usd
description: USD cost saved via context-cached input tokens

name: trace_id
description: OpenTelemetry / Cloud Trace trace ID (32 hex chars) of the API request that produced this row; joins to Cloud Trace and to Cloud Logging entries
